scope: Complete source-declared methods in TabbedToolbarTest and AttachedToolWindowTest only, under their named normal adt-ui target. Metadata only; no product Rust, test assertions, validator or frozen-input changes.

normal_execution_assumptions: Both concrete Kotlin classes have implicit Object superclass, no interface/test superclass, RunWith/Parameters/factory/dynamic declaration or Ignore annotations. Ordinary JUnit4 chooses one child per Test-annotated method; callbacks/event listener iteration/private helpers are not additional test invocations.
Compiled jar membership, actual JVM descriptions, runtime execution and infrastructure repeats were not run or inferred. No full module/global test census is claimed.
runner_resolution.toolbar_rule: RunsInEdt(writeIntent=false) with a single EdtRule. Matching-tag FixtureRule.kt resolves annotation and wraps one base.evaluate in runInEdtAndWait(false); it does not generate parameters.
runner_resolution.attached_rule: RunsInEdt defaults writeIntent=true. IntelliJ RuleChain order is EdtRule -> ProjectRule -> DisposableRule -> ActionPopupMenuRule -> FlagRule(DETACHABLE_ATTACHED_TOOLWINDOWS,true). Each wraps one statement; JUnit Before setUp runs once per method within the rule wrappers. The flag-off method overrides false within that invocation; FlagRule clears it afterward.
runner_resolution.shared_setup: setUp replaces application PropertiesComponent and WorkBenchManager and project DetachedToolWindowManager; creates WorkBench(project,DESIGNER,null,disposable,0), AttachedToolWindow(PALETTE definition, mocked drag listener/model,false), then FakeUi(createFakeWindow=true,parentDisposable=disposable). ProjectRule and helper fake services are harness adaptations, not extra test methods.
environment_inputs: getActionMask maps macOS to META_DOWN_MASK and other platforms to CTRL_DOWN_MASK; testCommandFStartsFiltering computes its input at runtime. Host OS is not a declared parameter provider.

Production includes NewUI.isEnabled-dependent painting/search preferred height. Selected suites do not declare NewUI parameterization; no old/new UI visual snapshots or platform-expanded execution are claimed.

Global suite/platform initialization, UI look-and-feel, localized action labels, icons, keymap and prebuilt Android Studio SDK affect these Swing tests. Matching-tag IntelliJ source is supplementary build-family evidence, not proof of byte-identical SDK dependency sources.

target_inventory.generated_input_variants: The complete adt-ui BUILD contains one iml_module and no explicit split_test_targets, shard count, old-AGP target generation or version-property overrides. Default iml_module/_gen_tests dispatch creates this single normal target. Arbitrary global/user configuration or other modules importing this jar remain outside this bounded claim.

behavioral_limits: TabbedToolbar is an embedded tool-window-like tab bar; AttachedToolWindow belongs to designer WorkBench. These inventories do not establish the IDE main window, editor tabs or IntelliJ global ToolWindow fidelity.

The selected tests assert component presence, labels, callbacks, property state and workflows. They are not visual screenshot/golden tests; full-app resizing, focus, accessibility, scrolling, rendering and performance still require separate ports and live checks.

Future Rust ports must retain assertions and distinguish a GPUI replacement of Swing/IntelliJ services from removal of user-facing behavior. No inapplicable classifications are justified solely by using GPUI.

The button-popup floating test verifies DETACHED after its second toggle; the header-gear test verifies FLOATING. These source expectations are retained exactly; a future behavioral implementation must investigate any discrepancy rather than silently harmonizing, skipping or weakening either assertion.
Existing 35 canonical rows and fresh source-bound run evidence remain unchanged from the inherited evidence snapshot. This task adds only unported/not_run cases and no new run credit.
